name: Ductable AC units
tagline: Concealed cooling for whole floors and large halls
description: Hidden-in-ceiling systems that distribute conditioned air through ducts for tidy, centralised cooling.
long_description: A ductable unit sits above the ceiling or in a service area and sends cool air through insulated ducts to grilles or diffusers in each zone. One machine can serve several rooms or a large hall, and the interior shows only the grilles. Good duct design matters as much as the unit, so we plan airflow, static pressure and return paths together.
features: Fully concealed, with only grilles or diffusers on show
One unit can serve multiple rooms or a large open area
Supports fresh-air mixing and better filtration
Suitable for banquet halls, offices, villas and retail floors
